t: 2032 — First long-duration wake protocols testbed runs a sealed sleep h
title: 2032 — First long-duration wake protocols testbed runs a sealed sleep h
definition: 2032 milestone on the Cryosleep Transit Habitats roadmap.
description:
First long-duration wake protocols testbed runs a sealed sleep hulls habitat for 1,000 days on Earth, proving the cryo pods recycling math.

What must be true first: the cryo pods results have to replicate outside the lab, transit propulsion manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and medical monitoring operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed cryo pods demonstrations, transit propulsion cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting medical monitoring uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Cryosleep Transit Habitats
definition: Estimates Cryosleep Transit Habitats readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Cryosleep Transit Habitats components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a sleep hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Cryosleep Transit Habitats Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Cryosleep Transit Habitats operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Cryosleep Transit Habitats installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 95073 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where cryo pods monitoring, transit propulsion redundancy, or medical monitoring maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Cryosleep Transit Habitats Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Cryosleep Transit Habitats: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Cryosleep Transit Habitats — habitats optimized for crews in long-duration sleep.

Phase 1 — Prove (cryo pods): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (transit propulsion): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (medical monitoring): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (wake protocols): sleep hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and interstellar-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
